import openpyxl, math
p='/workspace/inputs/Proteomic_data .xlsx'
for data_only in (False, True):
    wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p, read_only=True, data_only=data_only)
    ws=wb['Tumor vs Normal']
    headers=list(next(ws.iter_rows(min_row=1,max_row=1,values_only=True)))
    print('data_only',data_only)
    print('headers',headers)
    found=[]
    for rn,row in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True),2):
        gene=str(row[2]).strip().upper() if row[2] is not None else ''
        desc=str(row[1]).upper() if row[1] is not None else ''
        if gene == 'ENO1' or 'GN=ENO1' in desc:
            found.append((rn,row))
    print('count',len(found))
    for rn,row in found:
        print('row',rn)
        for h,v in zip(headers,row): print(repr(h),repr(v))
        n,t,ratio,stored=row[4],row[5],row[6],row[8]
        print('checks ratio',t/n,'log2',math.log2(t/n),'stored',stored)
